dz: 在林肯战役中法国战败后,法兰西王子路易批准了兰贝斯条约,根据该条约他放弃了对英国王位的所有主张并返回了法国以换取赔偿.
de: Following the French defeat in the battle of Lincoln, Prince Louis of France ratifies the treaty of Lambeth under which he abandons all claims to the English throne and returns to France in exchange of an indemnity payment.

dz: 在富尔福德战役中,哈拉尔德·哈德拉达击败了耳机摩卡尔和埃德温.

te: Agnes of Poitou and Andrew I of Hungary meet to negotiate about the border territory of Burgenland.
dz: 普伊图的艾格尼丝和匈牙利的安德鲁一世相会,商讨布尔根兰的边境领土.
de: Agnes of Poitou and Andrew I of Hungary meet to negotiate about the border territory of Burgenland.
